scenario_title: Build-to-play group session with constructive materials
minimal_context: The student is participating in a build-to-play group session using LEGO and magnetic vehicles.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our build-to-play group session. Let's use these LEGOs and magnetic vehicles to build something together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Singing in a high-pitched, changed voice) I am the boss of the building! Give me all the pieces right now!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just share the pieces with the other children.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches across the table, crossing boundaries to grab another child's magnetic vehicles) No, they are doing it wrong! I need them!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stay in your spot and keep building your own tower.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You are stupid! It's your fault it's ruined! (Throws the magnetic vehicles across the table)
